# FMagenticL v3.0 — Signed Malicious AI Agent & Offensive Harness Signature Registry

> Standalone, Ed25519-signed open registry of documented malicious AI agent signatures, offensive harnesses, poisoned MCP servers, and autonomous behavioral IOCs.

## Primary Endpoints
- Signed Snapshot: https://fmagenticl-registry.pages.dev/v1/snapshot.json
- Ed25519 Keyring: https://fmagenticl-registry.pages.dev/v1/keyring.json
- Per-Signature JSON: https://fmagenticl-registry.pages.dev/v1/signatures/SIG-2026-0001.json
- Streamable HTTP MCP (Read-Only): https://fmagenticl-registry.pages.dev/mcp

## Read-Only MCP Tools (3)
- `fmagenticl_lookup_signature(query)` — Exact lookup by `SIG-2026-XXXX`, CVE, GHSA, advisory ID (`FLASH-20261113-001`), or SHA-256 fingerprint.
- `fmagenticl_list_signatures(confidence_tier, threat_category, surface, severity, limit)` — Filter verified signatures.
- `fmagenticl_resolve(fingerprint, target, raw_error)` — Read-only exact resolver alias.
